outlets.name: Visit Gent (officiële stadstoerisme)
outlets.credible: Ghent's official tourism organisation; editorial POI, gastronomy and pub listings. Dutch/English authority for what the city itself presents to visitors.

outlets.name: Stad Gent (stadsbestuur, officieel)
outlets.credible: Official City of Ghent website (incl. muntenroute, klimaat/Donderdag Veggiedag, museum pages). Institutional for civic facts and city initiatives.

outlets.name: Toerisme Vlaanderen / VisitFlanders
outlets.credible: Official Flanders tourism board; Flemish Masters and heritage storytelling. Institutional for the Ghent Altarpiece and UNESCO sites.

outlets.name: VRT NWS (Vlaamse openbare omroep)
outlets.credible: Flanders' public broadcaster newsroom; used here for the cuberdon 'neuzekesoorlog' reporting. Highly credible native journalism.

outlets.name: National Geographic Nederland
outlets.credible: National Geographic NL edition; feature on the viral Ghent cuberdon rivalry. Credible international press.

outlets.name: Atlas Obscura
outlets.credible: Curated editorial on unusual places/foods; Gastro Obscura piece on the Ghent cuberdon war of the noses.

outlets.name: Le Guide Michelin België
outlets.credible: The Michelin Guide Belgium; star and selection listings. Lone-authority level for restaurant merit.

outlets.name: Gault&Millau België
outlets.credible: Gault&Millau Belgium guide and awards (incl. the chocolatier guide). Lone-authority level for restaurant/chocolatier merit.

outlets.name: Culinaire Ambiance
outlets.credible: Established Belgian culinary magazine; regional product and restaurant editorial (Gault&Millau roundups, Gentse mosterd).

outlets.name: Wikipedia (NL/EN)
outlets.credible: Encyclopaedic reference used as a corroborating source for dated historical/heritage facts, never as a lone recommender for merit.

outlets.name: Gent, De Kuip (lokale erfgoedgids)
outlets.credible: Detailed local heritage guide to Ghent's historic centre; corroborating source for monuments and squares, paired with an official source.

outlets.name: Toerisme Leiestreek (officieel regionaal toerisme)
outlets.credible: Official tourism board for the Leie region (Sint-Martens-Latem, Deurle, Deinze). Institutional for regional POI.

outlets.name: Onroerend Erfgoed (Vlaamse erfgoedinventaris)
outlets.credible: Official Flemish heritage inventory; protected-monument records. Institutional authority for built heritage.

outlets.name: UNESCO Vlaanderen
outlets.credible: Flemish UNESCO commission; the naming authority for the Flemish Beguinages and Belfries World Heritage inscriptions.

outlets.name: S.M.A.K. (officieel)
outlets.credible: Municipal Museum of Contemporary Art, official site. Institutional for the museum.

outlets.name: STAM Stadsmuseum Gent (officieel)
outlets.credible: Ghent City Museum, official site. Institutional for the museum and the Bijloke site.

outlets.name: Boekentoren UGent (officieel)
outlets.credible: Ghent University Book Tower (Henry van de Velde), official site. Institutional for the monument.

outlets.name: Sint-Niklaaskerk Gent (officieel)
outlets.credible: Official parish/heritage site of St Nicholas' Church. Institutional for the church.

outlets.name: Historiek.net
outlets.credible: Dutch-language history magazine; used for De Vooruit heritage context.

outlets.name: De Gentse Musea (stadsmusea-portaal)
outlets.credible: Official portal of Ghent's city museums. Institutional for museum facts.

outlets.name: Industriemuseum Gent (officieel)
outlets.credible: Ghent's industry/textile museum, official site (also holds the Tierenteyn-Verlent shopfront in its collection).

outlets.name: Gentse Stadsbrouwerij Gruut (officieel)
outlets.credible: City brewery's own site; the no-hop 'gruut' beers. Brewery-own source paired with a credible write-up for the beer layer.

outlets.name: De Hopduvel (officieel)
outlets.credible: Ghent beer specialty shop that commissioned the Gentse Tripel; own site.

outlets.name: Lost Beers (bierjournalistiek)
outlets.credible: Beer-heritage journalism revisiting Ghent's classic pubs ('A pub guide to Ghent, 32 years later'). Credible for the beer layer.

outlets.name: Verloren Bieren / Het Gentsche Kroegenboek
outlets.credible: Beer-heritage project documenting Ghent's historic cafés. Credible for the beer layer.

outlets.name: time to momo (reisgids)
outlets.credible: Established Dutch city-guide brand (print + online); curated Ghent food/nightlife editorial.

outlets.name: Reizen & Reistips
outlets.credible: Dutch travel outlet; curated Ghent beer-café guide. Corroborating source paired with an official one.

outlets.name: Be Vegan (België)
outlets.credible: Belgian vegan hotspot guide; corroborating source for the veggie-capital dining layer.

outlets.name: Greenway (officieel)
outlets.credible: Ghent's pioneering veg/vegan restaurant (since 1996), own site.

outlets.name: Feeling (Roularta magazine)
outlets.credible: Belgian lifestyle magazine (Roularta); curated Ghent coffee-bar and hotspot editorial.

outlets.name: Le Fooding
outlets.credible: Respected independent restaurant guide; Ghent listings (Amour, Martino, Elders).

outlets.name: june. a travel magazine
outlets.credible: Belgian travel/food magazine; curated Ghent coffee-bar features.

outlets.name: Marie Claire België
outlets.credible: Belgian edition; Ghent coffee-bar hotspot editorial.

outlets.name: ELLE België
outlets.credible: Belgian edition; Ghent nightlife/snackbar and student-life editorial.

outlets.name: Knack Weekend
outlets.credible: Weekend supplement of Knack (Roularta); restaurant reviews (De Superette) and veggie roundups.

outlets.name: Gentblogt (stadsarchief, stad.gent)
outlets.credible: Long-running Ghent city blog, archived on stad.gent; frituur and café editorial.

outlets.name: Julie's House (officieel)
outlets.credible: Ghent patisserie's own site.

outlets.name: Rutger Bakt (Rutger van den Broek)
outlets.credible: Bestselling Dutch baking author with a large following; published Ghent patissier/chocolatier guide.

outlets.name: Mokabon (officieel)
outlets.credible: Ghent coffee roastery since 1937, own site.

outlets.name: OR Coffee Roasters (officieel)
outlets.credible: Belgian specialty-coffee roaster with Ghent bars; own site.

outlets.name: Streekproduct.be (VLAM, erkende streekproducten)
outlets.credible: VLAM's recognised-regional-product register; Gentse mosterd / Tierenteyn-Verlent producer entry.

outlets.name: Souvenir (officieel)
outlets.credible: Ghent Michelin green-star restaurant, own site.

outlets.name: Vrijmoed (officieel)
outlets.credible: Two-Michelin-star restaurant, own site.

outlets.name: Sensum (officieel)
outlets.credible: Ghent Michelin-starred restaurant, own site.

outlets.name: Museum Dhondt-Dhaenens (officieel)
outlets.credible: Modern/contemporary art museum in Deurle, own site.

outlets.name: mudel — Museum van Deinze en de Leiestreek (officieel)
outlets.credible: Deinze fine-arts/folklore museum, own site.

outlets.name: Stad Deinze (officieel)
outlets.credible: Official City of Deinze website; museum and municipal facts.

outlets.name: Cultuurregio Leie Schelde
outlets.credible: Intermunicipal heritage body for the Leie-Schelde region; Deurle/Latem museum records.

outlets.name: Langs de Leie (regionaal toerisme)
outlets.credible: Leie-region tourism site; Ooidonk Castle and Leie-valley POI.

outlets.name: Brasserie Latem (officieel)
outlets.credible: Sint-Martens-Latem brasserie, own site.

outlets.name: Auberge du Pêcheur (officieel)
outlets.credible: Deurle riverside hotel-restaurant on the Leie, own site.

outlets.name: De Hipste Adresjes van Gent
outlets.credible: Curated Ghent hotspot blog with a long track record; corroborating source paired with an official/press source.

outlets.name: Shades of Ghent
outlets.credible: Ghent city-guide blog; coffee-bar features. Corroborating source.
